#   legA-fix5 (legs/legA-fix5/poll/poll.log): INIT byte +0x251 = 100;
#     (the Down release = stand). The measured crouch key is Down (VK_DOWN),
#     the client's live keymap -- fable's own duck key is C; the keys differ
#     between the two clients, the BYTES are what must match.
#   legA3_discovery (legs/legA3_discovery/poll/poll.log): INIT byte = 100,
#     and the byte NEVER left 100 through all of the SIT/USE probes -- the
#     one value-changing write was WR t=116.923 100->111 (step 35_use_space):
#     SPACE is crouch in the live keymap, not sit, not loot. So none of the
#     probed keys produces 110 (sit) or 105 (loot).
# KEY DISCOVERY (legC3b, the corrected 267-slot live keymap dump): the pending
# rows' keys are MEASURED, not guessed. The decode is anchored three ways:
# DUCK slot 12 high byte 0xD0 = "DOWN" in the namemap AND the oracle INI's
# KEYMAPPING_DUCK_1=208 (0xD0) AND the measured duck byte 111. With that:
#   SIT_STAND (action 138) k0 = 0x1F000100 -> high byte 0x1F = charmap 's'
#       (the low16 0x100 is the command-type flag the CMD_*/RTARGET slots
#       share -- it is not a key; the old legA3 poller misread the slot and
#       reported SIT_STAND "unbound", which is what this legC3b dump corrects)
#   USE (action 16) k0 = 0x16000000 -> high byte 0x16 = charmap 'u'
#   DUCK (action 12) k0 = 0xD0000000 -> high byte 0xD0 = "DOWN" (the crouch key)
# CAVEAT (config-specific, measured): the oracle INI sets KEYMAPPING_BACK_2=31
# (0x1F='s') for WASD movement, so 's' is bound to BOTH BACK (k1) and SIT_STAND
# (k0). The client fires every matching action (FUN_004ccd32: no early-break),
# so a 's' tap is expected to sit AND nudge backward; the +0x251 byte is the
# measurement either way. USE='u' has no conflict.
# The client's sit is a plain 100<->110 toggle in the setter 0x00483556 (the
# decompile shows no chair gate on the byte), so an open field is fine.
# PENDING rows: cast/stunned/stun-end are key-free (GM-command driven) and are
# measured by legC4.tsv (which adds a #set-time-23-0 GM-path verification so a
